behavior.disconnectEndpoint: DELETE /api/workspaces/:organizationId/social-connections/:id implemented with OWNER/ADMIN role authorization; non-privileged roles (EDITOR, CREATOR, ANALYST, CLIENT) rejected with 403/404
behavior.credentialScrubbing: Scrubs secret credential fields atomically: accessTokenCiphertext set to empty string sentinel, refreshTokenCiphertext set to null, expiration timestamps cleared, and revokedAt set to current timestamp
behavior.inFlightCascade: Active publication schedules transitioned from SCHEDULED to CANCELED (outcomeCode: CONNECTION_DISCONNECTED); RESERVED attempts transitioned to BLOCKED (AUTH_REVOKED); SUBMITTING attempts marked UNKNOWN (REVOKED_DURING_SUBMISSION)
behavior.referentialIntegrity: Hard-deletes connection when zero child records (PublicationAttempt, PublicationPolicyReview, PublicationSchedule) reference it; soft-disconnects with scrubbed tokens when historical references exist to preserve foreign key integrity
behavior.auditTrail: Emits immutable social_connection.disconnected event in AuditLog recording actorId, provider, externalAccountId, accountLabel, and hardDeleted status
behavior.tests: 11 unit tests in tests/data-governance.test.ts and comprehensive HTTP integration test in tests/integration/social-oauth.test.ts verifying authorization, hard-delete, soft-disconnect with credential erasure, in-flight schedule cancellation, and audit log entries

limits: External provider OAuth revocation remains bounded by provider network availability; local revocation and credential erasure are guaranteed immediately
Windows environment limits: full Compose verification runs on Linux CI
